text: Affidavit of A, aged about ....32........... years, son of Shri .........Raj kumar Yadav......... resident of ....Plot-45 industrial area Panchkula ,Haryana................ and B, aged about ........53........ years, son of Shri ........Ram........... resident of ..............Panchkula...................... text: 1.      That we, the deponents, are the witnesses to the execution of the will executed by Shri ............................ on ..................... and as such fully acquainted with the facts deposed to below. 2.      That the aforesaid testator Shri ......Arun Yadav.............. executed his last will on .........19-06-2024...................., in our presence. 3.      That the testator was healthy and of sound mind at the time of execution of the will.

metadata.source_file: affidavit for the registration of the will after the death of the testator.docx

text: 4.      That the testator executed his will on ........19-06-2024..................... of his own free will. 5.      That the testator signed the will after reading and understanding its contents in our presence. We, the above deponents do hereby declare and verify that the contents of paras 1 to 5 are true to our knowledge and nothing material has been concealed, no part of it is false.
